Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, her follow-up attacks are likely to land, so keep the minion wave between you and her. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on its return, and that damage is true damage. After dodging the first pass, keep moving out of its return path.
Ahri.build: Build magic resistance against Ahri's main ability damage, but first consider a way to interrupt or remove Ahri E Charm. Magic resistance does not reduce the true damage from the return of Ahri Q Orb of Deception, so you also need health. If healing from Ahri P Essence Theft is enough to prevent a finish with Akshan R Comeuppance, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Ahri.fight: Start a trade when you are close enough to hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang and the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is ready. If Q hits twice, land one basic attack for the third hit, bonus damage, and shield. Unless the kill is certain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing for your escape.
Ahri.laning: Stand behind minions to avoid Ahri E Charm, and harass Ahri with Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave. After throwing Q, move sideways toward the direction Ahri dodged its first pass to hit her with the return. After pushing the wave, use Akshan W Going Rogue to stay camouflaged along river or jungle walls while roaming, and check the cooldown of Akshan E Heroic Swing before returning.
Ahri.combo: Hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then land a basic attack to trigger the third hit of Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If you need to adjust your distance, cancel the second shot of your basic attack by moving to gain movement speed. If you need the full damage, fire both shots. Once Ahri E Charm is down and a kill is certain, take a wide path in with Akshan E Heroic Swing and fire.
Ahri.escape: Right after Ahri E Charm is used is your chance to engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is still available, account for her ability to dash away when judging whether you can secure the kill.
Ahri.phase: In the mid to late game, each critical strike item increases both Akshan's basic attack damage and his ability to finish targets with R.
Ahri.teamfight: Do not initiate from the front. After Ahri E Charm is down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish low-health targets. If an enemy becomes a Scoundrel by killing an ally, look for a chance to finish that enemy and revive your ally, but keep Akshan alive. When using Akshan R Comeuppance to finish a fleeing Ahri, check whether the front line or a turret will block the shots.

Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first shuriken from Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it marks you, her second dash will follow a fleeing Akshan. You cannot dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, so keep Akshan E Heroic Swing available for when Akali closes in.
Akali.build: Prioritize magic resistance early against Akali's magic damage. Then build health to delay the point at which the second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution becomes stronger. Consider movement speed so you can leave the telegraphed attack area.
Akali.fight: When the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is ready, hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang and trigger the third hit with a basic attack. Do not force your way into Akali W Twilight Shroud; fight back when Akali comes out to engage. Once Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution are down, close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing if the kill is certain.
Akali.laning: After throwing it, move sideways to line up its return path with the direction Akali dodged.
Akali.combo: After hitting both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, land one basic attack to trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If you need to create distance, cancel the second shot of your basic attack by moving to gain movement speed. Check Akali's remaining mobility, and engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing only when you are sure you can finish her.
Akali.escape: Do not engage just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down. Close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing when Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution are also down. If the kill is uncertain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to disengage.
Akali.phase: In the mid to late game, critical strike items increase Akshan's basic attack damage and finishing power.
Akali.teamfight: Do not initiate. Once the fight has started and the enemy's immobilizing abilities are down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing. Finish low-health targets; if an enemy has become a Scoundrel by killing an ally, look for a chance to finish that enemy. Akshan must survive for the revive to happen, so avoid an engage that will get him killed too.

Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup of Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and walk out of its area. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, use Akshan E Heroic Swing immediately to dodge the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam instead of waiting for the slow to wear off. Ambessa R Public Execution targets the farthest champion along a straight line, so do not stand on a line between Ambessa and your back line.
Ambessa.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Ambessa deals mainly physical damage and Akshan has relatively low armor, so build armor first. If healing from Ambessa R Public Execution is enough to prevent a finish, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Ambessa.fight: Start a trade right after Ambessa has used her abilities and charges of Ambessa P Drakehound's Step. Hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then land one basic attack for the bonus damage and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. Stop attacking when you see Ambessa W Repudiation, and save Akshan E Heroic Swing to disengage unless the kill is certain.
Ambessa.laning: Throw the boomerang through the minion wave to extend its range, then move sideways to aim its return for a second hit. When Ambessa's abilities are available, stay back and keep up in levels without giving her an early kill.
Ambessa.combo: Once Ambessa's abilities are down, hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then land one basic attack to trigger the third hit of Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If you need to adjust your distance, cancel the second shot of your basic attack by moving. Once Ambessa W Repudiation ends and the kill is certain, take a wide path in with Akshan E Heroic Swing, then finish a low-health Ambessa with Akshan R Comeuppance.
Ambessa.escape: Engage right after Ambessa has used all her abilities and charges of Ambessa P Drakehound's Step. In a teamfight, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing after Ambessa R Public Execution is down. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, use Akshan E Heroic Swing immediately to adjust your distance instead of waiting to engage.
Ambessa.phase: In the mid to late game, critical strike items increase Akshan's basic attack damage and the finishing power of Akshan R Comeuppance, so target low-health enemies.
Ambessa.teamfight: Do not initiate from the front. After Ambessa R Public Execution is down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish low-health targets. If an ally falls first and an enemy gains a Scoundrel mark, look for a chance to finish that enemy, but only engage if Akshan can survive. When using Akshan R Comeuppance, choose a path where the enemy front line or a turret will not block the shots.

Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost explodes and stuns where she reactivates it, so move beyond the explosion area rather than dodging just a little to the side. If Q hits you or you become chilled inside Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so leave the storm immediately. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape.
Anivia.build: Anivia's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If healing from Anivia P Rebirth is enough to prevent a finish, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Anivia.fight: Start a trade when you can hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang and the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is ready. Once Anivia Q Flash Frost and Anivia W Crystallize are down, close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If the kill is uncertain, save E so you have a way to disengage.
Anivia.laning: After pushing the wave, roam along river or jungle walls while using the camouflage from Akshan W Going Rogue.
Anivia.combo: Hit the first pass of Akshan Q Avengerang, then move sideways to aim its return for a second hit. If both passes hit, land one basic attack to trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. Once Anivia's crowd control is down and the kill is certain, follow her with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If a low-health Anivia flees in a direction without obstacles, finish her with Akshan R Comeuppance.
Anivia.escape: Anivia has no mobility ability, so look to engage when Anivia Q Flash Frost and Anivia W Crystallize are down. If Q hits you, stop fighting and use Akshan E Heroic Swing to leave Anivia R Glacial Storm, avoiding a follow-up Anivia E Frostbite.
Anivia.phase: Late in the game, watch for Anivia's terrain control. Akshan's basic attack damage and finishing power also increase as he builds critical strike items.
Anivia.teamfight: Avoid narrow corridors where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape, and fight in open areas. Do not initiate from the front. Once Anivia Q Flash Frost and Anivia W Crystallize are down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish low-health targets. If an ally falls first, look for a chance to finish the enemy who became a Scoundrel; Akshan must survive for the revive from Akshan W Going Rogue to happen.

Annie.watch: When the white glow showing Annie P Pyromania's stun appears, stay out of Annie's ability range. In teamfights, avoid standing on top of allies so Annie R Summon: Tibbers cannot stun you together, and keep your distance from the summoned Tibbers.
Annie.build: Annie deals magic damage, so build magic resistance first to survive one burst. Annie R Summon: Tibbers has magic penetration, so do not rely on resistance alone; consider movement speed to help escape its area damage.
Annie.fight: After Annie P Pyromania's stun is used, land both hits of Akshan Q Avengerang, then auto attack to trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting while trading. Use Akshan E Heroic Swing to close the gap when a kill is certain; otherwise, save it to disengage.
Annie.laning: Move sideways after throwing the boomerang to land its return hit, but keep your distance when Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready. After pushing the wave, roam along river or jungle walls using the camouflage from Akshan W Going Rogue.
Annie.combo: Land both hits of Akshan Q Avengerang, then auto attack once to trigger the bonus damage and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. When Annie P Pyromania's stun is used and you can kill her, close in and attack with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If a low-health Annie flees, finish her with Akshan R Comeuppance when no champion or turret blocks the shots.
Annie.escape: The moment Annie uses Annie P Pyromania's stun is your chance to engage. Annie has no mobility ability, so close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing if you can kill her. If the kill is uncertain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to escape.
Annie.phase: In the mid and late game, each critical strike item increases Akshan's auto attack damage and the finishing power of Akshan R Comeuppance.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is out of sight or Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, do not stand on top of allies. After Annie engages and uses her immobilizing ability, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish off low-health targets. If Annie killed an ally and has a Scoundrel mark, look to finish her from a position where you can survive and revive that ally.

AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health; prolonged exposure also deals bonus damage and gives him Stardust. Stand behind minions and leave its line of fire quickly. At low health, avoid even the edge of Aurelion Sol E Singularity, which can execute you; if caught, move out immediately. Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend applies crowd control, and with enough Stardust it gains a large area knockup, so spread out from allies later in the game.
AurelionSol.build: Aurelion Sol's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Because Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health, do not rely on stacking health alone; get movement speed to leave the telegraphed area of Aurelion Sol E Singularity.
AurelionSol.fight: Right after you force Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is a chance to close the gap. Land both hits of Akshan Q Avengerang to stack two hits of Akshan P Dirty Fighting, then auto attack to trigger the third hit and shield while trading. Close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing when a kill is certain; otherwise, save it to disengage.
AurelionSol.laning: Throw the boomerang through the minion wave to extend its range, but move behind minions to avoid taking Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light for too long and giving him Stardust. Pressure him early when Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down. After pushing the wave, roam along the river or jungle walls with Akshan W Going Rogue.
AurelionSol.combo: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang through minions, then move sideways to land the return hit. Follow with one auto attack to trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down and the kill is certain, take a wide swing to close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing. Finish a low-health target with Akshan R Comeuppance when no champion or turret blocks the shots.
AurelionSol.escape: Right after Aurelion Sol uses Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, if Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend are also down, you have a window to engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If the kill is uncertain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to escape instead of using it to engage.
AurelionSol.phase: Aurelion Sol permanently stacks Stardust and grows stronger as the game goes on, so slow his growth with early pressure and roams.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Let someone else engage. After Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend are used, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish off low-health enemies. Once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered, avoid grouping tightly with allies or overlapping your positions in narrow passages. If an ally dies first, look for a chance to finish an enemy marked by Akshan W Going Rogue, while staying alive so the revive can happen.

Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, move off the straight line between you and Aurora before the return hit. Its return damage increases with your missing health, so retreat instead of staying when you are below half health. Leaving the area after Aurora R Between Worlds forms slows you, so decide whether to exit before it forms.
Aurora.build: Akshan's mainly physical damage works well against Aurora's low armor, so prioritize your core damage items. If Aurora's healing prevents you from finishing her, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. If you need defense, build magic resistance against Aurora's magic damage.
Aurora.fight: Land both hits of Akshan Q Avengerang, then auto attack once to trigger the bonus damage and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting while trading. If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, use the movement speed from Akshan Q Avengerang or cancel the second auto attack shot to move out of its return path. Do not use Akshan E Heroic Swing to engage unless the kill is certain.
Aurora.laning: Throw the boomerang through minions to extend its range, then move sideways to line up its return hit on Aurora. After pushing the wave, you can roam along river or jungle walls while camouflaged by Akshan W Going Rogue.
Aurora.combo: Land both hits of Akshan Q Avengerang, then auto attack to trigger Akshan P Dirty Fighting. Once the stealth from Aurora W Across the Veil ends and her other escape tools are down, close the gap and shoot with Akshan E Heroic Swing if the kill is certain. If Aurora is low on health and no turret or other champion is in front of her, finish her with Akshan R Comeuppance.
Aurora.escape: Do not immediately commit deep when only Aurora W Across the Veil is down; Aurora can still escape with Aurora E The Weirding or Aurora R Between Worlds. The window to engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing is after the crowd control from Aurora Q Twofold Hex is used, especially before Aurora R Between Worlds is available again. If the kill is uncertain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to disengage.
Aurora.phase: Later in the game, critical strike items increase both your auto attack damage and finishing power, but do not stay in the fight at low health after being hit by Aurora Q Twofold Hex.
Aurora.teamfight: Let someone else engage. After the crowd control from Aurora Q Twofold Hex is used, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish off low-health targets. If Aurora leaps in but fails to contribute to a kill, look for a chance to kill her then. If an ally dies first and Aurora gains a Scoundrel mark, try to finish her for the revive while keeping Akshan alive.

Azir.watch: Stay out of the attack range of soldiers raised by Azir W Arise!, and watch for the moment Azir Q Conquering Sands moves them and applies a slow. Azir R Emperor's Divide pushes away an engaging Akshan, so especially in narrow passages, confirm it is down before going in.
Azir.build: The source does not specify a first purchase. If you need defense, choose magic resistance against Azir's magic damage and get movement speed to leave the areas where his soldiers attack. As you build critical strike items, both the finishing damage of Akshan R Comeuppance and your auto attack damage increase.
Azir.fight: When Azir's soldiers are stationary and he cannot immediately use Azir Q Conquering Sands, move out of their straight-line attack range and approach Azir himself. Land both hits of Akshan Q Avengerang, then auto attack to trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting for a short trade. Do not use Akshan E Heroic Swing to engage unless the kill is certain.
Azir.laning: After pushing the wave, use the camouflage from Akshan W Going Rogue along river or jungle walls when roaming.
Azir.combo: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave and move sideways to land the return hit. Follow with one auto attack to trigger the third hit of Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If Azir's escape tools are down and the kill is certain, close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing. When a low-health Azir flees in a direction without obstacles, finish him with Akshan R Comeuppance.
Azir.escape: Right after you force Azir E Shifting Sands is a chance to close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If Azir R Emperor's Divide is also down, engage with less risk of being pushed away. If Azir tries to escape to a soldier beyond a wall, position yourself in his path so Azir E Shifting Sands collides with you and stops.
Azir.teamfight: After Azir R Emperor's Divide is down, enter from the side in an open area with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish off low-health targets. If an ally dies first, look for a chance to finish an enemy marked by Akshan W Going Rogue. Akshan must survive for the revive to happen, so do not overcommit and die alongside them.

Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits, Cassiopeia E Twin Fang deals more damage and heals more while you are poisoned. Move out of range and fight again once the poison ends. Akshan E Heroic Swing cannot be used inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so go around it. When you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze begin, turn away to avoid the stun.
Cassiopeia.build: Akshan has more chances to secure a kill once he completes his first core item. If the healing from Cassiopeia E Twin Fang prevents a finish, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Cassiopeia deals mainly magic damage, so build magic resistance over armor.
Cassiopeia.fight: Look for short trades: hit Cassiopeia with Akshan Q Avengerang on both passes, then auto attack to trigger the bonus damage and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, back off until the poison ends. Use Akshan E Heroic Swing to close in when Cassiopeia W Miasma and Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze are down and the kill is certain.
Cassiopeia.laning: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave, then move sideways to hit Cassiopeia on its return path.
Cassiopeia.combo: Hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then trigger Akshan P Dirty Fighting with one auto attack. If Cassiopeia W Miasma and Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze are down and you can secure the kill, take a wide path in with Akshan E Heroic Swing and fire. Finish a low health Cassiopeia with Akshan R Comeuppance before she hides behind a turret or another enemy.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no mobility ability, so when Cassiopeia W Miasma and Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze are down, you have an opening to engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If Miasma is already on the ground, go around it instead of trying to use a mobility ability inside it. If the kill is uncertain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to escape.
Cassiopeia.phase: Cassiopeia has strong sustained damage late game. Avoid prolonged fights head-on and wait for an opening to engage.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Do not start the fight from the front. Once Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze and Cassiopeia W Miasma are down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish low health targets. If an enemy who killed an ally is marked as a Scoundrel, look to finish that enemy to trigger the revival from Akshan W Going Rogue, while keeping an escape route. When using Akshan R Comeuppance, choose an angle where the enemy frontline or a turret cannot block its shots.

Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages units near its first target, so leave its range instead of hiding behind minions. Reposition especially to avoid taking consecutive hits from the third missile. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces armor and magic resistance when it hits, so move sideways rather than holding your ground in front of him.
Corki.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Corki deals mainly physical damage and Akshan has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Resistance cannot block the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions; prioritize moving out of Corki E Gatling Gun.
Corki.fight: Trade when you can hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang and use one auto attack to get the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If Corki W Valkyrie is available, do not force an engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing. Close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing right after Corki uses Corki W Valkyrie.
Corki.laning: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave to extend its range, then move sideways to land the returning hit. Pressure Corki during the first five levels so he cannot farm freely, and create gank opportunities.
Corki.combo: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave at Corki, then move sideways to hit him on both passes. Follow with one auto attack to trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If Corki W Valkyrie is down and the kill is certain, follow with Akshan E Heroic Swing, then escape with Akshan E Heroic Swing after a takedown resets it.
Corki.escape: The moment after forcing Corki W Valkyrie is your opening to engage. Close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing, but keep an escape option if the kill is uncertain. While Corki E Gatling Gun is hitting you from the front, move sideways out of it before looking for an angle to engage.
Corki.phase: Corki grows stronger as he gets items. In the mid to late game, shut down his growth so he cannot keep using Corki R Missile Barrage from a safe position.
Corki.teamfight: Do not start the fight from the front. After the enemy's immobilizing abilities are down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish low health targets. When using Akshan R Comeuppance on a fleeing Corki, choose an angle where the frontline or a turret cannot block its shots. If an ally falls first, look for a chance to finish an enemy marked by Akshan W Going Rogue; Akshan must survive to revive the ally.

Ekko.watch: When you see the indicator for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. The returning hit of Ekko Q Timewinder hurts more, so move out of its return path. If Ekko's afterimage is visible, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready; do not overcommit to a chase even if he is low health.
Ekko.build: The available information does not determine a first purchase. Build magic resistance against Ekko's damage. If Akshan E Heroic Swing is unavailable and avoiding the stun is difficult, consider tenacity first. If the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak prevents a finish, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Ekko.fight: Start a trade when you can hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang and the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is ready. After the two Avengerang hits, auto attack for the third hit, and cancel the second shot by moving if you need to adjust your spacing. Dodge Ekko W Parallel Convergence, then engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing when Ekko R Chronobreak is down.
Ekko.laning: Move sideways after throwing Akshan Q Avengerang to adjust its return path, and step out of the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. When roaming after pushing the wave, use Akshan W Going Rogue along river or jungle walls.
Ekko.combo: Hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then use one auto attack to trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. Leave the area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence; if Ekko R Chronobreak is down, take a wide path in with Akshan E Heroic Swing. Once Ekko is low health, finish him with Akshan R Comeuppance, checking that no frontline enemy or turret stands between you to block the shots.
Ekko.escape: The safest opening to engage is when both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, he can still escape with Ekko R Chronobreak, so do not rush an engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If the kill is uncertain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to escape.
Ekko.phase: As Akshan builds critical strike items late game, both his auto attack damage and the finishing power of Akshan R Comeuppance increase.
Ekko.teamfight: Akshan should not start the fight from the front. After Ekko W Parallel Convergence is down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish low health enemies. If an enemy who killed an ally is marked as a Scoundrel, look for a chance to finish that enemy. Akshan must survive for the revival to happen, so avoid engaging when the kill is uncertain.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike travels in a curve, so dodge sideways instead of only retreating. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush may reset; use Akshan E Heroic Swing to create distance. Do not fight at close range until the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone.
Diana.build: The available information does not determine a first purchase. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance against Diana's magic damage. The finishing power of Akshan R Comeuppance grows as Akshan builds critical strike items in the mid to late game.
Diana.fight: Trade when you can hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then use one auto attack to trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. Cancel the second auto attack shot by moving to adjust your spacing, then attack again after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone. If the kill is uncertain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to escape.
Diana.combo: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang beyond the minion wave and move sideways to land its returning hit. If both passes hit, use one auto attack to gain the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. When Diana W Pale Cascade is down and the kill is certain, engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing to finish her, then escape with Akshan E Heroic Swing after a takedown resets it.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without a mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike, the moment after she uses that mobility ability is a chance to fight while adjusting your distance with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If her mark hits you first, Diana E Lunar Rush may reset, so delay your engage and create distance. In teamfights, look to enter from the side after Diana R Moonfall is down.
Diana.phase: In the mid to late game, Akshan's auto attack damage and finishing power grow as he builds critical strike items.
Diana.teamfight: Space out according to Diana's angle of entry so Diana R Moonfall does not pull several allies together. After Diana R Moonfall is down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish low health targets. If an enemy has killed an ally, look to finish that enemy for the revival from Akshan W Going Rogue, but fight from an angle where Akshan can survive.

Fizz.watch: Fizz E Playful / Trickster is used both to engage and escape, so do not swing deep with Akshan E Heroic Swing before Fizz uses it. If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts.
Fizz.build: Akshan has more opportunities to secure a kill once he has his first core item. Fizz deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance over armor. The source does not specify a first item.
Fizz.fight: Trade when you can hit Fizz with both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then land one basic attack for the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, use Akshan E Heroic Swing to close the gap, but save it to escape unless the kill is certain.
Fizz.laning: Look for a trade if Fizz misses a last hit with the empowered basic attack from Fizz W Seastone Trident and it goes on cooldown. When you push the wave and roam, use the camouflage from Akshan W Going Rogue along river and jungle walls.
Fizz.combo: After throwing Akshan Q Avengerang, move sideways to hit Fizz on its return path too. Follow with one basic attack to trigger the third hit of Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down and the kill is certain, follow with Akshan E Heroic Swing to finish him.
Fizz.escape: The moment Fizz E Playful / Trickster goes on cooldown is Akshan’s chance to engage. Fizz Q Urchin Strike may still be available, so do not chase recklessly just because one mobility spell is down. In teamfights, wait until the crowd control from Fizz R Chum the Waters is also down, then enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing.
Fizz.phase: Early on, Fizz cannot use Fizz E Playful / Trickster often because of its mana cost, so look to act right after he uses it.
Fizz.teamfight: Stay with your allies to make Fizz use Fizz E Playful / Trickster first. Once the crowd control from Fizz R Chum the Waters is down, enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish off a low-health target. If an enemy becomes a Scoundrel by killing an ally, look for a chance to finish them, but only take an engage Akshan can survive.

Galio.watch: Charging Galio W Shield of Durand reduces the damage Galio takes and extends his taunt, so hold your damage and walk out of range. Dodge when you see Galio step back for Galio E Justice Punch, and move away from the point where the two gusts of Galio Q Winds of War meet. If the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance appears, leave its area immediately.
Galio.build: Akshan has more opportunities to secure a kill once he completes his first core item. Against Galio’s main sources of damage, prioritize magic resistance over armor. Galio Q Winds of War deals damage based on maximum health, so be cautious about building a large amount of health alone.
Galio.fight: Start a trade when you can hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang and the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is ready. Back off while Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand, then engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing after his taunt and Galio E Justice Punch are down. If the kill is uncertain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to escape.
Galio.laning: Early on, pressure Galio with both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang through the minions instead of relying on basic attack trades. When Galio uses spells to clear the wave and spends his mana, push the lane to give him less room to influence other lanes with Galio R Hero's Entrance. When you push and roam, use the camouflage from Akshan W Going Rogue along river and jungle walls.
Galio.combo: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang past the minion wave and move sideways to land its return hit. Then use one basic attack to trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If Galio’s crowd control is down and the kill is certain, engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing to finish him.
Galio.escape: Do not engage as soon as Galio E Justice Punch alone is down. If the taunt from Galio W Shield of Durand is also down and Galio R Hero's Entrance has not come back up, close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If the kill is uncertain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing so you can escape.
Galio.phase: Later on, as you build more critical strike items, the finishing power of Akshan R Comeuppance and Akshan’s basic attack damage increase. Finish off low-health targets.
Galio.teamfight: Do not start the fight. After the crowd control from Galio W Shield of Durand, Galio E Justice Punch, and Galio R Hero's Entrance is down, enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If an ally dies first, look for a chance to finish an enemy marked by Akshan W Going Rogue. Akshan must survive to secure the revive, so avoid an engage that gets him killed too.

Hwei.watch: If the root or pull from Hwei E Subject: Torment catches you, his follow-up spells are likely to hit too. If the first spell hits, immediately reposition by moving or using Akshan E Heroic Swing to dodge the second. Watch out for the slow from Hwei R Spiraling Despair as well.
Hwei.build: Look for a kill once you complete your first core item, when your opportunities to secure one increase. Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Hwei’s magic damage. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on maximum health, so be cautious about building a large amount of health alone.
Hwei.fight: Hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then land one basic attack to trigger the bonus damage and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is down and you see a chance to kill, close in from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If the kill is uncertain, do not spend Akshan E Heroic Swing on the engage and lose your escape.
Hwei.laning: Early on, avoid straight basic attack trades and poke Hwei with Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave. Move sideways after throwing it to adjust its return path, and trade when the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is ready. When you push the wave and roam, use the camouflage from Akshan W Going Rogue along walls.
Hwei.combo: Hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang and add one basic attack to trigger Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If you need to adjust your spacing, cancel the second shot of your basic attack by moving. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is down and you can finish him, close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing and use Akshan R Comeuppance on the low-health Hwei.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility spell, so the moment after he uses Hwei E Subject: Torment to poke or clear the wave is your opening to engage. Close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing then. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, delay the engage because he can root or displace you.
Hwei.phase: Later on, as you build more critical strike items, Akshan’s basic attack damage and the finishing power of Akshan R Comeuppance increase.
Hwei.teamfight: Do not engage first from the front. Once Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish off low-health targets. Avoid corridors covered by Hwei’s area effects and take a wider route in. If an ally dies, look for a chance to finish an enemy with a Scoundrel mark, but first judge whether Akshan can survive.

Irelia.watch: Irelia can approach by chaining Irelia Q Bladesurge through low-health minions, so keep your distance as minions are about to die. Dodge the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you are trapped by the barrier from Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.
Irelia.build: Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Akshan’s armor is fairly low, so start with Cloth Armor and build armor first. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If the healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge prevents you from finishing her, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Irelia.fight: When the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is ready, start a trade from a range where you can hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang. Bait out Irelia Q Bladesurge; if Irelia E Flawless Duet is down too, look for a chance to close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish her. If the kill is uncertain, do not spend Akshan E Heroic Swing on the engage and lose your escape.
Irelia.laning: Do not leave low-health minions between you and Irelia that could give her a route in with Irelia Q Bladesurge. When you push the wave and roam, use the camouflage from Akshan W Going Rogue along river and jungle walls.
Irelia.combo: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave and move sideways to land its return hit. If both passes hit, use one basic attack to trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. When Irelia’s mobility spell and stun are down and the kill is certain, close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing, then finish the low-health Irelia with Akshan R Comeuppance.
Irelia.escape: Right after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge is an opening to engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing. Check that the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet is down too before going in. If the kill is uncertain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to escape.
Irelia.phase: In the mid to late game, building more critical strike items increases both Akshan’s finishing power and his basic attack damage.
Irelia.teamfight: Do not start the fight from the front. After Irelia E Flawless Duet is down, enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing. Prioritize Irelia because she can control a teamfight with Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet. If an ally dies first, look for a chance to finish the enemy who became a Scoundrel and secure the revive from Akshan W Going Rogue, while making sure Akshan does not die too.

Karma.watch: Repeated hits from Karma Q Inner Flame reduce Karma R Mantra's cooldown through Karma P Gathering Fire, so dodge behind minions or stay out of range. Leave the area immediately after a Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma Q Inner Flame explodes. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, move far enough away to break it before the root lands.
Karma.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma W Focused Resolve. If the healing from a Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma W Focused Resolve would stop you from finishing her, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Letting her heal removes the finishing opportunity from Akshan R Comeuppance, which deals damage based on missing health.
Karma.fight: Trade when you can hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then land one basic attack to trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If you need to adjust your spacing, move after the first shot to cancel the second and gain movement speed. Close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing when Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the kill is certain.
Karma.laning: Early on, avoid trading basic attacks alone. Trade only when both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang can hit. Send Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave to extend its range, then move sideways to adjust its return path. After pushing the wave, roam along river or jungle walls using the camouflage from Akshan W Going Rogue.
Karma.combo: When Karma W Focused Resolve is down, hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang and land one basic attack to trigger Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If the kill is certain, approach from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing to finish her, then escape with the reset Akshan E Heroic Swing. If the low-health Karma is not shielded by a frontline champion or turret, finish her with Akshan R Comeuppance.
Karma.escape: Do not engage first with Akshan E Heroic Swing while Karma W Focused Resolve is available. Close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing when Karma W Focused Resolve is down or the root threat from a Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma W Focused Resolve has passed. If the shield from a Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire is active, engage after it ends.
Karma.phase: Late game, as you build critical strike items, both your basic attack damage and the finishing power of Akshan R Comeuppance increase. Look for low-health targets.
Karma.teamfight: Wait until Karma W Focused Resolve is down. If a Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire shield is active, engage after it ends. Once the fight starts, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish low-health targets. If an enemy has killed an ally, look for a chance to finish the enemy marked by Akshan W Going Rogue, but engage only if Akshan can survive.

Kassadin.watch: Watch out for the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse, and avoid using unnecessary abilities near Kassadin that would reduce its cooldown.
Kassadin.build: The available information does not specify a first purchase. Against Kassadin's damage, build magic resistance rather than armor. Kassadin W Nether Blade restores mana, so there is no reason to prioritize healing reduction.
Kassadin.fight: Start a trade when you can hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then land one basic attack to trigger the bonus damage and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If you need to adjust your spacing, move to cancel the basic attack's second shot. Close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing when Kassadin R Riftwalk is down or the kill is certain.
Kassadin.laning: After throwing Akshan Q Avengerang, move sideways to set up a hit with the returning boomerang. Push the wave to keep Kassadin at his turret, then pressure him with your jungler to build a level and CS lead.
Kassadin.combo: Hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then land one basic attack to trigger Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If Kassadin R Riftwalk is down and the kill is certain, close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing to finish him. Use Akshan R Comeuppance on a low-health Kassadin only when no frontline champion or turret can block its shots along his escape path.
Kassadin.escape: If the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse is also down, it is a good time to close the gap. If the kill is not certain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to escape.
Kassadin.phase: Later in the game, watch for Kassadin entering your backline and look for chances to finish off low-health targets as Akshan.
Kassadin.teamfight: Do not start the fight from the front. Once the enemy's immobilizing abilities are down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish low-health targets. Do not stand alone within range of Kassadin R Riftwalk. Even when targeting a scoundrel who killed an ally, choose an angle where Akshan can survive and finish the target.

Leblanc.watch: If the mark from LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice remains on you, her next ability combo is dangerous. Back off to give it time to expire. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Akshan E Heroic Swing to get beyond the chain's range before the root lands.
Leblanc.build: Prioritize a spell shield against LeBlanc's opening ability. If building defensive stats, choose magic resistance over armor, and consider movement speed to help leave telegraphed attack areas.
Leblanc.fight: Trade when the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is ready and you can hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang. Close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing once LeBlanc W Distortion's return window has expired or been used, and both LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and LeBlanc R Mimic are down.
Leblanc.laning: Early on, avoid trading basic attacks alone. Poke LeBlanc with Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave. If LeBlanc leaves lane, alert your team immediately. When roaming, push the wave first, then use the camouflage from Akshan W Going Rogue along river and jungle walls.
Leblanc.combo: Hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then land one basic attack to trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If you need to create distance, move to cancel the basic attack's second shot. Once LeBlanc W Distortion's return window has ended, close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing if the kill is certain.
Leblanc.escape: Right after you draw out LeBlanc W Distortion is a chance to close the gap, but do not chase all the way to its return point while she can still return. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains or LeBlanc R Mimic is available, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to disengage and go in after her crowd control is used.
Leblanc.teamfight: Do not start the fight from the front. Once LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and LeBlanc R Mimic are down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish low-health targets. If an enemy who killed an ally has a scoundrel mark, look for a chance to finish them while keeping an escape route for Akshan.

Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard passes through minions after hitting one, so do not stand in line with your minions. Getting caught by the root from Lissandra W Ring of Frost and the stun from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is dangerous, so do not go deep with Akshan E Heroic Swing while both are available. Lissandra can also cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on herself, so do not commit all your finishing damage at once.
Lissandra.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Lissandra's damage. If the healing from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is enough to prevent a kill, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Lissandra.fight: Trade immediately after Lissandra uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it. Hit with both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then auto attack to trigger Akshan P Dirty Fighting's third hit and gain its shield. If Lissandra E Glacial Path is also down, close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing, but keep it available for escape if the kill is uncertain.
Lissandra.laning: Stand at an angle to your minions to avoid the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard after it pierces them. When you push the wave and roam, use Akshan W Going Rogue's camouflage along river or jungle walls.
Lissandra.combo: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave and move sideways to land its return hit. If both passes hit, one auto attack triggers Akshan P Dirty Fighting's third hit. When Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra E Glacial Path are down and you have a kill opportunity, follow with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish a low health Lissandra with Akshan R Comeuppance.
Lissandra.escape: Right after Lissandra uses Lissandra E Glacial Path is your window to close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb are still available, delay your engage and come in from the side after her immobilizing abilities are down.
Lissandra.phase: Late game, each critical strike item increases both your auto attack damage and the finishing power of Akshan R Comeuppance. Target low health enemies after Lissandra's crowd control is down.
Lissandra.teamfight: Do not start fights from the front. Once Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb are down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If she has also used Lissandra E Glacial Path, you have a chance to finish her while she has no escape. If an ally dies first, look for the enemy marked by Akshan W Going Rogue, but Akshan must survive for the revive to happen.

Lux.watch: Getting caught by Lux Q Light Binding makes her follow up abilities hard to dodge. Bait it out and approach after it misses. Leave the area covered by Lux E Lucent Singularity, and dodge sideways when the red targeting line of Lux R Final Spark appears.
Lux.build: The provided material does not specify an item to buy first. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Lux's damage. Movement speed also helps you leave the area marked by Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Lux.fight: Close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing as soon as Lux Q Light Binding misses. Trade when you can land both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang and trigger Akshan P Dirty Fighting with an auto attack. Cancel the second shot by moving if you need to adjust your spacing.
Lux.laning: Avoid straight auto attack trades early. Trade only when both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang will hit. Throw it through the minion wave and move sideways to adjust its return path. Lux Q Light Binding roots the first two targets it hits, so do not stand in line with an ally.
Lux.combo: After dodging Lux Q Light Binding, land both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang. Follow with one auto attack for Akshan P Dirty Fighting's third hit and shield, then close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing if the kill is certain. When a low health Lux flees, finish her with Akshan R Comeuppance from an angle where no frontline champion or turret can block the shots.
Lux.escape: Your opening is immediately after Lux Q Light Binding misses. Lux has no mobility ability, so close the gap then with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If the kill is uncertain, do not use Akshan E Heroic Swing to engage and leave yourself without an escape.
Lux.phase: In the mid to late game, critical strike items increase both your auto attack damage and the finishing power of Akshan R Comeuppance.
Lux.teamfight: Do not start fights from the front. After Lux Q Light Binding is down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing. Approach from a different direction than your allies so Lux E Lucent Singularity cannot stop you together, then finish low health targets. If an enemy who killed an ally has a Scoundrel mark, look for a chance to finish them, but Akshan must survive for the revive to happen.

Naafiri.watch: If the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers applies bleed, keep your distance until the bleed ends to avoid the second hit. Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit dashes to a targeted champion, so do not travel alone while it is available. Naafiri cannot be targeted during the brief period when Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, so use Akshan R Comeuppance after it ends.
Naafiri.build: Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, and Akshan has relatively low armor, so buy Cloth Armor early to survive. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and prioritize armor. If healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate is enough to prevent a kill, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Naafiri.fight: Trade by landing both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then auto attacking to trigger Akshan P Dirty Fighting's bonus damage and shield. Right after Naafiri E Eviscerate, clear her pack and look for a counterattack. If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate are down and Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit has not come back up, confirm the kill opportunity and close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing.
Naafiri.laning: Akshan is weak in straight auto attack fights early. Stay behind your minion line and gain an advantage through both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang and the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. Do not give Naafiri an angle to close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate. Move sideways after throwing Akshan Q Avengerang to land its return hit. Naafiri's pack clears waves, so do not try to hold a complete freeze.
Naafiri.combo: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave to hit Naafiri on both passes, then use one auto attack to complete Akshan P Dirty Fighting's third hit. If you need distance, cancel the second auto attack shot by moving; if you can deal the full damage, fire both shots. Engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing when Naafiri's mobility is down and the kill is certain. Finish a low health Naafiri with Akshan R Comeuppance where no frontline champion or turret can block the shots.
Naafiri.escape: Do not engage just because Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers is down. Your window to enter with Akshan E Heroic Swing is when Naafiri E Eviscerate is also down and Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit has not come back up. If the kill is uncertain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to escape. If you take part in a kill, use the reset Akshan E Heroic Swing to get out.
Naafiri.phase: Late game, when your team groups to start a head on teamfight, area damage can wipe out Naafiri's pack and reduce her damage. Akshan's finishing power grows as he gains critical strike items.
Naafiri.teamfight: Do not start fights from the front. After the enemy's immobilizing abilities are down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish low health targets. If an ally dies first, look for a chance to finish the enemy marked by Akshan W Going Rogue, but check whether Akshan can survive. If Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is available again, retreat immediately to avoid being picked off in succession.

Mel.watch: The center of Mel E Solar Snare roots you and can be followed by Mel Q Radiant Volley, so dodge sideways and save Akshan E Heroic Swing for that moment. Akshan Q Avengerang can be reflected while Mel W Rebuttal is active, so bait out Mel W Rebuttal with an auto attack first. If you have taken several hits of poke, beware of the execute from Mel P Searing Brilliance and the unlimited range of Mel R Golden Eclipse, even if you still have health left.
Mel.build: On your first purchase, prioritize magic resistance against Mel's magic damage. Armor does not help against damage from Mel P Searing Brilliance, Mel Q Radiant Volley, or Mel E Solar Snare. The provided material does not establish a specific item to buy.
Mel.fight: Start a trade when you can land both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang and use one auto attack to trigger Akshan P Dirty Fighting's bonus damage and shield. Cancel the second auto attack shot by moving if you need to adjust your spacing. Approach with Akshan E Heroic Swing when Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal are down and the kill is certain.
Mel.laning: Trade when the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is ready, and push or pressure the lane early to slow the growth of Mel R Golden Eclipse. After pushing the wave, use Akshan W Going Rogue's camouflage along river or jungle walls when you roam.
Mel.combo: Bait out Mel W Rebuttal with an auto attack, then dodge Mel E Solar Snare sideways to create an opening. Land both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then use one auto attack to trigger Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If the kill is certain, follow with Akshan E Heroic Swing. When a low health Mel flees, finish her with Akshan R Comeuppance.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility ability, so after Mel E Solar Snare is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If Mel W Rebuttal is also down, there is less risk of Akshan Q Avengerang being reflected. When the kill is uncertain, do not spend the Akshan E Heroic Swing you need to escape on your engage.
Mel.phase: The growth Mel gains through Mel R Golden Eclipse is permanent, so she becomes stronger over time. Delay that point with early pressure.
Mel.teamfight: After Mel E Solar Snare is down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish low health targets. If an enemy who killed an ally has a Scoundrel mark, finish that enemy to trigger the revive from Akshan W Going Rogue. Akshan must stay alive for the revive to happen, so avoid an engage that would kill you too.

Malzahar.watch: When a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect spreads to a nearby target, so do not stand beside it to last-hit. When Malzahar Q Call of the Void appears, move outside the line between its portals and wait for the silence to end before going in. Akshan E Heroic Swing and shields cannot break Malzahar R Nether Grasp, so do not enter unwarded areas alone while his R is available.
Malzahar.build: Build magic resistance early against Malzahar Q Call of the Void, W Void Swarm, and E Malefic Visions. If you need to break Malzahar R Nether Grasp yourself, buy Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar. His R deals damage based on maximum health, so do not rely on stacking health alone.
Malzahar.fight: Use Akshan Q Avengerang to remove Malzahar P Void Shift first, then aim to trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting with the returning boomerang and a basic attack. A spent Malzahar Q Call of the Void silence and no voidlings give you a chance to close the gap. Go in with Akshan E Heroic Swing only when you are sure you can secure the kill; otherwise, save it to escape.
Malzahar.laning: Back away from minions affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions, then resume pressure once they are cleared. If Malzahar pushes the lane, remove his P Void Shift and look for a chance to catch him with your jungler.
Malzahar.combo: Remove Malzahar P Void Shift with the first hit of Akshan Q Avengerang, then move toward the side Malzahar dodged to hit him with the returning boomerang. Follow with a basic attack to trigger the third hit of Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void is down and the kill is certain, close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing and fire.
Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no mobility ability to create distance, so use Akshan E Heroic Swing to close in when the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void is down and there are no voidlings from his W Void Swarm. Do not force a solo engage while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available. If his R suppresses you, you cannot escape with a mobility ability; use Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar, or have an ally interrupt Malzahar's cast.
Malzahar.phase: Late game, watch Malzahar's scaling and look for chances to finish off low-health targets with Akshan R Comeuppance.
Malzahar.teamfight: Do not start the fight from the front. Once Malzahar R Nether Grasp is down, enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If voidlings from Malzahar W Void Swarm are present, clear them first or wait for them to disappear. If a Scoundrel has killed an ally, look to finish that target for the revive from Akshan W Going Rogue, but fight from a position where Akshan can survive.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows larger and faster after hitting a target, so do not line up behind minions or allies. If Neeko approaches while disguised, the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom may be hidden; create distance before a suspicious target gets close. Do not chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; watch the real Neeko's position.
Neeko.build: Build magic resistance early against the magic damage from Neeko Q Blooming Burst, W Shapesplitter, and E Tangle-Barbs. If getting rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs lets Neeko R Pop Blossom kill you, prioritize tenacity. Movement speed also helps you leave the area of a telegraphed area attack.
Neeko.fight: Hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then trade with a basic attack to trigger the bonus damage and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If you need to adjust your spacing, cancel the second shot of your basic attack by moving. Close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing when Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and R Pop Blossom are down and the kill is certain.
Neeko.laning: Send the boomerang through the minion wave to extend its range, then move sideways after throwing it to land the returning hit. After pushing the wave, you can roam along river or jungle walls while camouflaged by Akshan W Going Rogue.
Neeko.combo: Hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then use one basic attack to complete the third hit of Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down and you can secure the kill, approach from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing and fire. Once Neeko is low, finish her with Akshan R Comeuppance where no champion or turret blocks the shots.
Neeko.escape: Wait until Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is also down before going in to avoid the root. If the kill is uncertain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to escape.
Neeko.phase: In the mid and late game, each critical strike item increases the finishing power of Akshan R Comeuppance and his basic attack damage. Watch for Neeko R Pop Blossom and look for openings from the flank.
Neeko.teamfight: Do not start the fight from the front. Once Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and R Pop Blossom are down, enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing and clean up low-health enemies. Neeko may approach while disguised, so spread out with your allies before a suspicious target gets close. If a Scoundrel kills an ally, look for a chance to finish that target, but Akshan must survive for the revive to happen.

Orianna.watch: Watch where the ball lands after Orianna Q Command: Attack and reposition to avoid being pulled by Orianna R Command: Shockwave near it. Also watch for the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and the empowered consecutive basic attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup.
Orianna.build: Prioritize completing your first core item. After that, critical strike items increase both the finishing damage of Akshan R Comeuppance and his basic attack damage. Magic resistance counters Orianna's magic damage.
Orianna.fight: Right after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her, hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then use a basic attack to gain the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If the kill is certain, close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing.
Orianna.laning: Move sideways after throwing the boomerang to adjust its return path, and trade only when your shield is ready. If you have pushed the wave, you can activate Akshan W Going Rogue and roam along river or jungle walls.
Orianna.combo: Right after Orianna Q Command: Attack, hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then trigger Akshan P Dirty Fighting with one basic attack. If you need to adjust your spacing, cancel the second shot of your basic attack by moving; if you can finish her, close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing. Against a low-health opponent fleeing, fire Akshan R Comeuppance where the frontline or a turret cannot block its shots.
Orianna.escape: Once Orianna R Command: Shockwave is down, you have an opening to engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing. Orianna has no ability to create distance on her own, but save Akshan E Heroic Swing to escape if the kill is uncertain.
Orianna.phase: Late game, each critical strike item increases both your basic attack damage and the finishing power of Akshan R Comeuppance.
Orianna.teamfight: Do not start the fight from the front. Once Orianna R Command: Shockwave is down, enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing and clean up low-health targets. If an ally falls first, look for a chance to finish the enemy marked by Akshan W Going Rogue, but you must survive for the revive to happen.

Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal roots with the river element and grants stealth with the brush element. If she approaches holding the river element, back out of range; if she disappears with the brush element, move into your allies' vision. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes and stuns when it reaches a wall, so do not stand with your back to a wall, and avoid meeting her in the river or narrow passages.
Qiyana.build: Buy Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Qiyana's main damage is physical and Akshan has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Qiyana.fight: Start a trade when you can hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting with a basic attack. If Qiyana stays in front of you after using Qiyana W Terrashape and E Audacity, counterattack. Go in with Akshan E Heroic Swing when the kill is certain.
Qiyana.laning: When you push the wave and roam, use Akshan W Going Rogue to move along walls, but choose a route that avoids meeting Qiyana in the river or a narrow passage.
Qiyana.combo: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang past the minions and move sideways to land the returning hit, then trigger Akshan P Dirty Fighting with a basic attack. Once Qiyana's mobility and crowd control are down and a kill is possible, take a wide swing with Akshan E Heroic Swing, fire, and land where you want.
Qiyana.escape: If only Qiyana W Terrashape is down, wait to engage because she can still escape with Qiyana E Audacity. Close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing before Qiyana E Audacity comes back up and after the crowd control from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and R Supreme Display of Talent is down.
Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so avoid giving her an advantage and build armor. Late game, Qiyana becomes relatively weaker while Akshan's finishing power and basic attack damage increase. Move together, but stay away from walls to avoid an opening for Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent.
Qiyana.teamfight: Do not start the fight from the front. Once Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and R Supreme Display of Talent are down, enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing and clean up low-health targets. If a Scoundrel kills an ally, look to finish that enemy for the revive from Akshan W Going Rogue, but fight from a position where Akshan can survive.

Sylas.watch: Watch the chain after the first dash of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If it hits, you are knocked up and vulnerable to follow-up attacks, so use Akshan E Heroic Swing to dodge the chain. At the crossing point of Sylas Q Chain Lash, leave before the delayed explosion.
Sylas.build: If the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer prevents a finish, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. When you need resistance, build magic resistance against Sylas's magic damage.
Sylas.fight: Hit with Akshan Q Avengerang on both passes, then add an auto attack to trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. Cancel the second shot by moving when you need distance. Engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing once Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down and the kill is certain.
Sylas.laning: When roaming, use the camouflage from Akshan W Going Rogue along river or jungle walls.
Sylas.combo: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave and move sideways to land the returning hit. If both hits land, one auto attack triggers Akshan P Dirty Fighting. Once Sylas's mobility and crowd control are down and the kill is certain, chase with Akshan E Heroic Swing, then use Akshan R Comeuppance on the wounded target.
Sylas.escape: Even after dodging the chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, do not rush in if Sylas W Kingslayer is still available. Close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing while both of Sylas's mobility options are down, especially before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct comes back up. If the kill is uncertain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to escape.
Sylas.phase: In the mid and late game, each critical strike item increases Akshan's auto attack damage and the finishing power of Akshan R Comeuppance.
Sylas.teamfight: Do not start the fight from the front. After Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish wounded targets. If an enemy who killed an ally has a Scoundrel mark, finish that enemy to seek the revive. Akshan must survive for the revive to happen.

Ryze.watch: Prioritize dodging the mark from Ryze E Spell Flux. If marked, Ryze W Rune Prison becomes a root and Ryze Q Overload deals more damage. If the mark lands, stay away from allies and keep your distance until it expires.
Ryze.build: Ryze deals mainly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Get movement speed to help leave Ryze's attack range. Akshan's physical damage works well against Ryze's low armor.
Ryze.fight: Trade when you can hit with Akshan Q Avengerang on both passes, then trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting with one auto attack. Look for a chance to close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing if Ryze W Rune Prison is down or you have dodged the mark from Ryze E Spell Flux. If the kill is not certain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to escape.
Ryze.laning: Check that your shield is ready before trading, and pressure Ryze while his early mana and damage are low to slow his scaling. After pushing the wave, use the camouflage from Akshan W Going Rogue along river or jungle walls when moving out.
Ryze.combo: Send Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave to hit Ryze on the first pass, then immediately move sideways to land the returning hit. Follow with one auto attack to trigger the third hit from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If the kill is certain and Ryze W Rune Prison is down, close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing. Finish with Akshan R Comeuppance when the wounded Ryze flees in a direction with no obstacles.
Ryze.escape: The window to engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing is after Ryze W Rune Prison is down.
Ryze.phase: In the mid game, kill opportunities widen once you have Akshan R Comeuppance and your first core item. In the late game, critical strike items increase both Akshan's finishing power and auto attack damage, so clean up wounded targets.
Ryze.teamfight: Do not start the fight from the front. After Ryze W Rune Prison is down, enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish wounded targets. If an enemy who killed an ally has a Scoundrel mark, finish that enemy to seek the revive. Akshan must be alive for the revive to happen, so avoid an engage that will get you killed too.

Syndra.watch: Syndra E Scatter the Weak knocks back and slows in an area, and a pushed Syndra Q Dark Sphere stuns if it hits you. If a sphere lies between you and Syndra, move out of its path. Do not engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing before Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down. Move away from areas with several spheres, where Syndra R Unleashed Power deals more damage.
Syndra.build: Buy boots early for movement speed so you can more easily sidestep Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Build magic resistance first against Syndra's main source of damage. Also consider your total health because of the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.fight: Start a trade when the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is ready and you can hit with Akshan Q Avengerang on both passes. Once Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, close the gap and attack with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If the kill is not certain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing so you retain a way to escape.
Syndra.laning: Early on, avoid trading with auto attacks alone. Send Akshan Q Avengerang past the minion wave to harass on both passes. Move sideways after throwing it to adjust the return path, and walk out of areas where Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will are placed. When roaming after pushing the wave, use the camouflage from Akshan W Going Rogue along river and jungle walls.
Syndra.combo: Land both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then use one auto attack to trigger the bonus damage and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, take a wide route in with Akshan E Heroic Swing while avoiding the line between Syndra and her spheres. When Syndra is low and fleeing, finish with Akshan R Comeuppance where no turret or other champion stands in its path.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak is Syndra's only self-defense tool, so the window to engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing is right after she uses it. If the kill is certain, engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing and escape after a takedown resets it.
Syndra.phase: In the late game, critical strike items increase Akshan's auto attack damage and finishing power. Target a wounded Syndra after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down.
Syndra.teamfight: Do not start the fight from the front. After Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing. Avoid areas with several Syndra Q Dark Spheres and finish wounded targets. If an enemy who killed an ally has a Scoundrel mark, use the pursuit from Akshan W Going Rogue to finish that enemy, but Akshan must survive for the revive.

Talon.watch: If the first hit of Talon W Rake lands, move out of its return path to prevent passive stacks and bleed. Do not chase too far while Talon R Shadow Assault is available; he can use its stealth to escape or counterattack.
Talon.build: Talon deals physical damage, so buy Cloth Armor to survive early and build armor first. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If the healing from Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy prevents Akshan R Comeuppance from finishing him, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Talon.fight: When the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is ready, start a trade from a range where you can hit with Akshan Q Avengerang on both passes. Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, you can close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If the kill is not certain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing so you retain a way to escape.
Talon.laning: Push the wave first so Talon does not reach the next level before you. If Talon roams, share his position and place vision along jungle routes. You can also push the lane to make him return to farm.
Talon.combo: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave and move sideways to land the returning hit. If both hits land, one auto attack gives you the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is down and the kill is certain, engage and fire with Akshan E Heroic Swing, then finish the wounded Talon with Akshan R Comeuppance.
Talon.escape: Right after you draw out Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is the window to engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing. Dodge the returning blades from Talon W Rake first. If Talon has already used Talon R Shadow Assault, counterattack during that window.
Talon.phase: In the mid game, look for kills once you have Akshan R Comeuppance and your first core item, while using vision and position calls to stop Talon's fast roams. In the late game, Talon's impact falls, while each critical strike item increases Akshan's auto attack damage and finishing power.
Talon.teamfight: Fight grouped together. If Talon reaches the backline, respond with your allies by layering crowd control. Akshan should not start the fight. Once the enemy's immobilizing abilities are down, enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish wounded targets. If Talon kills an ally and becomes a Scoundrel, finish him to seek the revive from Akshan W Going Rogue, but Akshan must survive.

Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge. If trapped inside, move within it and wait for it to disappear instead of running into the edge, or use Akshan E Heroic Swing to escape. The landing spot of Veigar W Dark Matter is shown in advance, so keep moving to dodge it. If you are below half health, move out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which grows stronger based on your missing health.
Veigar.build: Veigar Q Baleful Strike, Veigar W Dark Matter, and Veigar R Primordial Burst deal magic damage, so build magic resistance over armor. Getting movement speed first is useful for leaving the marked area of Veigar W Dark Matter.
Veigar.fight: Start a trade when you can hit with both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang and the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is ready. After two Q hits, land one basic attack to trigger the third hit. If Veigar E Event Horizon is down, close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing.
Veigar.laning: Pressure Veigar early with Akshan Q Avengerang before he builds stacks, disrupting his farming and poke. Throw Q through the minion wave to reach Veigar behind it, then move sideways to hit him with the returning boomerang. Veigar Q Baleful Strike passes through only the first two units it hits, so position behind minions to find an angle to dodge it.
Veigar.combo: Hit Veigar with both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then use one basic attack to trigger the third hit of Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If Veigar E Event Horizon is down and you are sure you can get the kill, take a wide swing around to him with Akshan E Heroic Swing. Finish a low-health Veigar with Akshan R Comeuppance when he flees without a frontline or turret blocking him.
Veigar.escape: After Veigar E Event Horizon is down, look for a chance to engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If the kill is uncertain, keep E as an escape instead of using it to engage. If trapped inside Veigar E Event Horizon, do not cross its edge blindly; use E when escaping.
Veigar.teamfight: After Veigar E Event Horizon is down, enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing to finish low-health targets. Before the fight, check Veigar's position and whether he has used E. If you can finish a scoundrel who killed an ally, look for the revive, but make sure Akshan can get out alive.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in a gold card with W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you. Wait outside his basic attack range. Take hits from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards behind minions to reduce its poke damage.
TwistedFate.build: The available information is insufficient to recommend a specific first purchase. Choose magic resistance over armor against Twisted Fate's damage. Movement speed is also valuable for leaving marked areas.
TwistedFate.fight: Start a trade when the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is ready and you can hit with both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang. Right after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If you are unsure you can get the kill, save E to escape.
TwistedFate.laning: Early on, avoid fights based purely on basic attacks. Look to poke with both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave. Stand behind minions against Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
TwistedFate.combo: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave, then move sideways to land the returning hit. If both passes hit, use one basic attack to get the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. Once the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is down, close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing to finish him if the kill is certain.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is your window to engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing.
TwistedFate.phase: Late game, as you build more critical strike items, Akshan's basic attack damage and ability to finish targets increase. Fight after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is down.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Wait for Twisted Fate W Pick a Card to be down instead of starting the fight from the front. Then enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing to finish low-health targets. If an enemy who killed an ally is marked as a scoundrel, finish that enemy for the revive, but fight from an angle where Akshan can survive.

Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion heals him and becomes empowered, so keep your distance when his empowered Q is ready. When Vladimir charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. Vladimir R Hemoplague increases the damage you take while affected, so reengage after it ends.
Vladimir.build: Vladimir's offensive abilities deal magic damage, so build magic resistance early. Consider Blade of The Ruined King as a physical damage item against Vladimir when he builds health. If his healing prevents you from finishing him, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
