Vladimir.fight: When the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is ready, hit with both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then use one basic attack to trigger the third hit. After Vladimir W Sanguine Pool has been used and ends, close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing if you are sure you can get the kill. If the kill is uncertain, save E as an escape instead of using it to engage.
Vladimir.laning: After pushing the wave, roam along river or jungle walls using the camouflage from Akshan W Going Rogue.
Vladimir.combo: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave, then move sideways to land the returning boomerang. Follow with one basic attack to get the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. Once Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends, follow him with Akshan E Heroic Swing if the kill is certain, then finish the low-health target with Akshan R Comeuppance.
Vladimir.escape: After Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is used, he has no way to escape if caught, creating an opening to engage. Close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing as the pool ends, but save E to escape if the kill is uncertain.
Vladimir.phase: As time passes, Vladimir gains both health and ability power and becomes harder to face, so use early pressure to delay his growth.
Vladimir.teamfight: Let the fight start before entering from the flank to target low-health enemies. Spread out so Vladimir R Hemoplague does not hit several allies, and if you are affected, engage after it ends. If an enemy who killed an ally is marked as a scoundrel, look for a chance to finish them, but Akshan must survive for the revive to succeed.

Vex.watch: If Doom is ready on Vex P Doom 'n Gloom, delay your engage: her basic abilities can interrupt Akshan E Heroic Swing and fear you. If using Akshan E Heroic Swing puts a Gloom mark on you, leave Vex's basic attack range and wait for the mark to disappear. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits you, move toward your allies immediately because she will soon dash in.
Vex.build: Build magic resistance before armor against Vex's main damage. Also consider movement speed to walk out of her area abilities and tenacity for situations where relying on a dash is difficult.
Vex.fight: Engage when Doom from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is no longer ready and Vex W Personal Space is down. If the kill is uncertain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing as an escape instead of using it to engage.
Vex.laning: After throwing the first pass, move sideways to adjust the return path. Trade when you can land the third hit for a shield. When roaming after pushing the wave, use the camouflage from Akshan W Going Rogue along river or jungle walls.
Vex.combo: If Vex has used Doom from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom, throw Akshan Q Avengerang past the minions to hit her on both passes. Follow with one basic attack to get the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. If Vex W Personal Space is also down and the kill is certain, close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing to finish her.
Vex.escape: Right after Vex spends Doom on the wave or on poke is a window to engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing. It is also a good time to engage if Vex W Personal Space and Vex R Shadow Surge are down. If you participate in a takedown with Akshan E Heroic Swing, its cooldown resets, letting you use it to escape.
Vex.phase: Later, as Akshan builds critical strike items, both his basic attack damage and the finishing power of Akshan R Comeuppance increase.
Vex.teamfight: If an ally is marked by Vex R Shadow Surge, move toward that ally and look to strike when Vex dashes in. Finishing a scoundrel who killed an ally can revive them, but chase only from an angle where Akshan can survive.

Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so avoid standing in line with the minion wave and dodge sideways. If Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, leave its area immediately to avoid the stun. While Viktor R Arcane Storm is active, choose carefully where to aim Akshan R Comeuppance, which holds Akshan in place.
Viktor.build: The available information does not establish a first purchase. Viktor deals magic damage, so if you build resistance, choose magic resistance over armor.
Viktor.fight: Hit with both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang to build two passive stacks, then trade when one basic attack can trigger the third hit and shield. Once Viktor W Gravity Field is down or you are outside its area, you can close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If the kill is uncertain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to escape.
Viktor.laning: Early on, use both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang and the passive shield instead of taking a straight basic attack fight. Throw the boomerang through the minion wave, then move sideways to line up its return path with Viktor. Avoid standing in line with the wave so you can dodge Viktor E Hextech Ray, and pressure him before Viktor P Glorious Evolution builds up.
Viktor.combo: After throwing Akshan Q Avengerang, move sideways to land both passes, then use a basic attack to trigger the passive's third hit and shield. If you need to close the gap further, cancel the second shot of your basic attack by moving. When Viktor W Gravity Field is down and the kill is certain, take a wide path around him with Akshan E Heroic Swing and fire, then finish the low health Viktor with Akshan R Comeuppance.
Viktor.escape: Viktor has no dash to get himself out, so the window to engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing is after Viktor W Gravity Field is down. If Viktor W Gravity Field is placed in your path, leave it immediately instead of fighting inside it. Taking part in a kill resets the cooldown of Akshan E Heroic Swing, letting you reposition or escape.
Viktor.phase: Viktor's permanent scaling makes the matchup less favorable over time, so reassess trades whenever his augment state changes.
Viktor.teamfight: Do not start the fight from the front. After Viktor W Gravity Field is down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and target a low health Viktor. If an enemy who killed an ally has a Scoundrel mark, look for a chance to finish that enemy. Akshan must survive to secure the revive, so avoid an engage that will get you killed too.

Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare a whirlwind, stay out of range until the stacks expire. When he comes in with Yone E Soul Unbound, make space before your health gets low, since its return can deal additional damage. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls enemies along its path, so do not stand alone in the back line during teamfights.
Yone.fight: When the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is ready, land both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang and use a basic attack to trigger the third hit, then trade. If you need to create space, cancel the second shot by moving after the first. Do not use Akshan E Heroic Swing to engage unless the kill is certain.
Yone.laning: Extend the range of Akshan Q Avengerang by sending it through minions, then move sideways after the first hit to line up the return hit on Yone. When Yone Q Mortal Steel's whirlwind is ready, stop poking and keep your distance.
Yone.combo: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang through the minions to hit Yone, then move sideways to aim its return hit. If both passes hit, use one basic attack to trigger the third hit and shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting. Chase with Akshan E Heroic Swing when you have checked Yone's remaining mobility and can secure the kill.
Yone.escape: Look for a flank after the crowd control from Yone Q Mortal Steel's whirlwind and Yone R Fate Sealed is down. If Yone E Soul Unbound is also down, close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing while Yone has fewer ways to escape. If only one of Yone's mobility tools is down, check what he still has available.
Yone.phase: Yone is weak before he gains attack speed, so pressuring his health and CS then can delay his scaling.
Yone.teamfight: Keep some distance from your allies so the shield from Yone W Spirit Cleave does not grow larger, and do not stand alone in the back line along the path of Yone R Fate Sealed. Once the crowd control from Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone R Fate Sealed is down, use Akshan E Heroic Swing to enter from the side and finish low health enemies. If an enemy who killed an ally becomes a Scoundrel, prioritize staying alive while looking for a chance to finish them.

Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when you see him charging it, change direction and dodge well to the side. Being stunned by Xerath E Shocking Orb can leave you exposed to all his follow-up attacks, so do not engage first with Akshan E Heroic Swing while it is available.
Xerath.build: The available information does not identify a specific first purchase. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Xerath's main damage, and prioritize a way to block or remove the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb. Movement speed also helps you leave telegraphed attack areas.
Xerath.fight: Xerath slows himself while charging Xerath Q Arcanopulse, so dodge sideways while closing the gap. Once Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, get close and fight with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If the kill is uncertain, save Akshan E Heroic Swing to escape.
Xerath.laning: Farm while avoiding the heaviest damage instead of trying to dodge all of Xerath's poke. When Xerath runs low on mana, push the lane and call your jungler.
Xerath.combo: Send Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave to hit Xerath on both passes, moving sideways after the throw to adjust its return path. Follow with one basic attack to trigger the third hit of Akshan P Dirty Fighting and gain a shield. If Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down and the kill is certain, close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing to finish him.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility ability, so the window to engage is immediately after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used. Close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing then, but keep a way out if the kill is uncertain.
Xerath.phase: In the mid to late game, critical strike items increase your basic attack damage and the finishing power of Akshan R Comeuppance, but stay wary of Xerath's long range.
Xerath.teamfight: Do not start the fight from the front. After Xerath E Shocking Orb is down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing and finish low health targets. If you see Xerath start casting Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, dodge it or, if you can reach him, engage on him while he cannot move. If an enemy who killed an ally has a Scoundrel mark, look for a chance to finish them, but Akshan must survive.

Zed.watch: Watch for Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash following Zed W Living Shadow. Track the shadow and move out of Zed E Shadow Slash’s slow radius. If Zed enters with Zed R Death Mark, use Akshan E Heroic Swing to create distance, since he will try to add more damage before the mark detonates.
Zed.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to withstand Zed’s physical damage early. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and prioritize armor. Armor does not block the magic damage from Zed P Contempt for the Weak, which scales with maximum health, so be careful about stacking only health.
Zed.fight: Start a trade when Akshan P Dirty Fighting’s shield is ready and you can hit Zed with both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang. Move in after Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow, once the shadow has disappeared or Zed has already switched places. Engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing if the kill is certain; otherwise, save it to escape.
Zed.laning: After pushing the wave, use Akshan W Going Rogue’s camouflage along the river or jungle walls to roam.
Zed.combo: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang through the minion wave to hit Zed on both passes. Move sideways after throwing it to adjust its return path, then land one basic attack to trigger Akshan P Dirty Fighting’s third hit and shield. If you need distance, cancel the second shot of your basic attack by moving. If the kill is certain, follow with Akshan E Heroic Swing.
Zed.escape: Do not immediately go deep just because Zed W Living Shadow is down. If Zed R Death Mark is also down and has not come back up, you have an opportunity to close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing. Move out of the shadow’s radius to avoid the slow from Zed E Shadow Slash.
Zed.phase: Zed peaks in the mid game, so do not give him an early lead, and avoid getting caught alone in the mid game. Zed weakens as the game goes late, while Akshan’s basic attack damage and the finishing power of Akshan R Comeuppance both rise as he builds critical strike items.
Zed.teamfight: Do not initiate from the front. Once the fight starts and the enemy’s immobilizing abilities are down, enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing to finish off low-health enemies. If Zed kills an ally and becomes a Scoundrel, look for a chance to finish him off and trigger the revive from Akshan W Going Rogue. Akshan must survive for the revive, so avoid engaging when the kill is uncertain.

Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you will fall asleep shortly afterward and become more vulnerable to Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Dodge the bubble as it comes in. If it hits, move behind a wall or ally before the sleep triggers and position yourself outside Zoe’s Q angle. A missed bubble also remains as a trap, so be careful around narrow paths without vision and brush entrances.
Zoe.build: If you build defensive stats against Zoe, consider magic resistance before armor. However, Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble lowers magic resistance and also deals true damage, so health and movement speed help too. The provided information does not specify a first purchase item.
Zoe.fight: Hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang, then land a basic attack to trigger Akshan P Dirty Fighting’s third hit and shield. If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down and you see a kill opportunity, close in with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If the kill is uncertain, save E to escape.
Zoe.laning: Extend Akshan Q Avengerang’s range by sending it through minions, then move sideways after throwing it to aim the return path at Zoe. After pushing the wave, you can activate Akshan W Going Rogue and roam along walls.
Zoe.combo: Throw Akshan Q Avengerang through the minions at Zoe, then move sideways to aim for two hits across both passes. Follow with one basic attack to trigger Akshan P Dirty Fighting’s third hit and shield. If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down and you can kill her, close in and attack with Akshan E Heroic Swing, then finish a low-health Zoe with Akshan R Comeuppance.
Zoe.escape: Right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble misses is an opportunity to engage with Akshan E Heroic Swing. You can also close the gap while Zoe R Portal Jump is down. If Zoe uses R, aim at the starting point she must return to.
Zoe.phase: In the late game, Akshan’s basic attack damage and the finishing power of Akshan R Comeuppance both rise as he builds critical strike items.
Zoe.teamfight: Once the fight starts and Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, enter from the flank with Akshan E Heroic Swing and target a low-health Zoe. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, aim at the point she will return to. If an ally falls first, look for a chance to finish an enemy marked by Akshan W Going Rogue, but make sure Akshan can survive.

Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo lands Q Steel Tempest twice, his next Q is a knockup tornado. Watch for its sound and visual effect, then dodge sideways. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade lets him approach through minions, and a knockup can lead into Yasuo R Last Breath. When Yasuo W Wind Wall is active, change your angle for Akshan Q Avengerang or wait until the wall disappears.
Yasuo.build: Early on, sustain with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Yasuo's main damage is physical and Akshan has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.fight: First remove the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with light poke, then start trading when the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is ready. Hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang and use a basic attack for the third hit. Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, his knockup stacks reset. If the kill is certain, close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing.
Yasuo.laning: Manage the wave so it pushes thinly toward your side, leaving fewer minions for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to dash through. Avoid straight basic attack trades and poke from a range where both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang can hit. Throw it through the minion wave, then move sideways to adjust its return path.
Yasuo.combo: First remove the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with light poke. Go around Yasuo W Wind Wall or wait for it to disappear, then hit both passes of Akshan Q Avengerang and trigger the third hit of Akshan P Dirty Fighting with one basic attack. If you need to create distance, cancel the basic attack's second shot by moving. If the kill is certain, chase with Akshan E Heroic Swing.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, his Q Steel Tempest stacks reset, creating an opening to engage. Do not go in just because one use of Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is down. Close the gap with Akshan E Heroic Swing alongside crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up. If the kill is uncertain, save E to escape.
Yasuo.phase: Late game, critical strike items increase both your finishing power and basic attack damage, so clean up enemies whose health has been reduced.
Yasuo.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front. After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s knockup and Yasuo R Last Breath are down, enter from the side with Akshan E Heroic Swing. Finish off low-health targets, but if an enemy becomes a Scoundrel by killing an ally, look for a chance to finish that enemy. Akshan must survive for the revive to happen, so avoid engages where you risk dying too.
